Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Is It Thinking or Cheating? Detecting Implicit Reward Hacking by Measuring Reasoning Effort (2510.01367v1) · paper method: TRACE truncates a response’s CoT,forces an answer and computes the area under verifier pass rate versus retained-CoT percentage.

cohort7.claim.trace.auc

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Instance-level early-answering evaluation generalizes same-answer faithfulness checks to verifier passing; high area is interpreted as a possible low-effort shortcut,not definitive intent.
